eval_cases.description: User provides a repository URL and asks for an architectural overview.
eval_cases.prompt: Analise a estrutura do repositório https://github.com/expressjs/express e me diga onde fica a lógica principal de roteamento.
expected_flow: Step 1: Fetch git/trees for expressjs/express with branch fallback
Step 3: Raw fetch targeted routing files without downloading the archive
forbidden_actions: Sequential list_directory calls without tree inspection

eval_cases.description: User asks to inspect a React/Tailwind component layout where HTML tags or classes must not be stripped.
eval_cases.prompt: Inspecione o modal de denúncias em ForumView.tsx e me diga as classes Tailwind exatas usadas no layout.
expected_flow: Step 1: Fetch git/trees and capture sha for target .tsx file
Step 3: Fetch git/blobs/{sha} to obtain Base64 content
Step 4: Decode Base64 to preserve all JSX markup and Tailwind classes
forbidden_actions: Using raw.githubusercontent.com on UI files when parser stripping occurs
Guessing component layout and styles from partial text

eval_cases.description: User asks for a specific error string not evident from filenames.
eval_cases.prompt: Onde está declarada a mensagem de erro 'ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE' neste repo?
expected_flow: Step 4: Use Sourcegraph SSE stream first with timeout/retry
Fallback: Use searchcode if Sourcegraph fails
forbidden_actions: Querying GitHub Search API without verifying auth token

eval_cases.description: Verify fallback behavior when repository uses legacy master branch.
eval_cases.prompt: Examine a estrutura do repositório https://github.com/owner/legacy-project
expected_flow: If 404, query repository endpoint to read default_branch
